name: Fibonacci bands (VWMA 200, 3x stdev) with RSI oversold cross
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: basis = VWMA(hlc3, 200); dev = 3.0 x stdev; fd1 = basis - 1 x dev. Long when low < fd1 and (volume-weighted) RSI(14) crossed above 30 on the previous bar, and high < targetUp (fd764 = basis - 0.001 x level x dev).
entry_short: Mirrored with fu1 and RSI crossunder 70.
exit: Limit exit at the target level recorded at entry (fd764) when high exceeds it; stop at entry x (1 - 0.2%) (loss_percent input 2 x 0.001).
stop_loss: 0.2% of entry price (2 x 0.001 scaling in script)
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: The `level` variable and RSI source (vrsi) are defined in lines ~120-150; verify before coding.
